name: poly(rC) binding protein 1
pathways: positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: PCBP1 encodes poly(rC)-binding protein 1. Annotated molecular activities include cadherin binding and mRNA binding. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and viral RNA genome replication.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.
